snippet: Refractory Castables, Refractory Plastics, Refractory Mortars ## Able Insulating Castable Products #### Able Insulcast 28 28000F insulating castable used primarily in soaking pit covers because of its light weight and excellent insulation characteristics. #### Able Insulcast 28G 28000F insulating gunning mix. It has all of the light weight and excellent insulating characteristics as its casting counterpart. #### Able Insulcast 28 LW - Data Sheet pdf Low iron insulating castable. It has high strength and low thermal conductivity in addition to its light weight. #### Able Insulcast 28 LWG - Low iron, 28000F insulating gunning mix. It has high strength and low thermal conductivity in addition to its light weight characteristics. #### Able Insulcast 25 LW - Data Sheet pdf Insulating refractory castable for use limit of 25000F. It may be used as a back-up insulation material or in direct contact with furnace conditions. It has good refractoriness and spall resistance. A feature of all Able insulating castables is their heat saving value, lightness of weight with a strong hydraulic setting, negligible shrinkage, good high-temperature strength and desirable refractoriness. #### Able Insulcast 25 G Insulating, gunning castable for use limit of 25000F. It has good refractoriness and spall resistance in addition to light weight. #### Able Insulcast 24 LI - Data Sheet pdf Low iron insulating hydraulic setting refractory which can be either cast or gunned into place. It can be used as a back-up lining for a dense refractory as it has low thermal conductivity, or it can be used as an exposed lining where conditions are not severe. #### Able Insulcast 23 LW - Data Sheet pdf Insulating refractory castable for use up to 28000F. It is a hydraulic setting castable which can be used as a back-up lining for a dense refractory as it has low thermal conductivity, or it can be used as an exposed lining where conditions are not severe. #### Able Insulcast 20 Hydraulic setting insulating castable for use up to 20000F. Outstanding features include good strength and low thermal conductivity for a lightweight material. #### Able Insulcast 18 A very lightweight castable (approximately 50 pounds per cubic foot). It provides an excellent insulation as back-up material between a more refractory hot face lining and the furnace shell. It has good strength and its light, porous structure makes it an excellent material for hot face use where temperatures of 18000F are not exceeded. #### Able Insulcast 16 Hydraulic setting insulating castable for use up to 16000E Its outstanding feature is its very low thermal conductivity. It provides excellent insulation as a back-up material for refractory brick or dense castables. #### Able 1-2-4 - Data Sheet pdf Blend of lumnite cement with haydite and vermiculite aggregates. It provides an excellent insulation as back-up material or as a hot face lining when temperatures do not exceed 20000F. #### Able 1-4 - Data Sheet pdf Blend of lumnite cement and a haydite aggregate. It is a low-cost insulating material that provides insulation as a back-up material or as a hot face lining when temperatures do not exceed 20000F and conditions are not severe.
